BrochureContent.Content:
Edel Quinn Properties are proud to present this 4 bedroom detached home with stunning sea views to the market.

This property in Dromore Upper, Mountcharles presents incredible views as far as the eye can see. The property sits on an elevated site looking over Donegal Bay and the Bluestack Mountains.

Upon entry you are greeted by a spacious entrance hall which loops around firstly through the large sitting room with sea views, into the kitchen/dining room and back to the hallway. The utility room has plenty of space also and is plumbed with high/low level units.

Downstairs boasts a well proportioned bedroom along with a walk in wardrobe and en suite. There is also a second WC on the ground floor.

Upstairs comprises x3 bedrooms of good size, as well as a large hot press and bathroom. 

This property has a fantastic B3 energy rating and is a great prospect for the lucky buyers.
